title: Koya Lead Agent
summary: An evidence-grounded lead research and outreach-drafting system that discovers companies, researches public sources, qualifies leads, drafts outreach, and routes uncertain decisions through human review.
problem: Lead research is easy to automate badly. A useful system has to turn a vague objective into explicit qualification criteria, collect trustworthy company evidence, keep long-running research observable, control cost and provider usage, and avoid turning uncertain research into confident outreach claims.
system: The application converts a user objective into an explicit ICP, discovers candidate companies, researches public company websites, records evidence-backed qualification decisions, drafts a three-step email sequence plus a LinkedIn message, and keeps a human reviewer in control of final qualification and copy approval.

engineeringDecisions.title: Separate web and worker processes
engineeringDecisions.detail: Long agent runs execute outside the request lifecycle so the interface stays responsive while work continues durably.

engineeringDecisions.title: Enforce limits outside the model
engineeringDecisions.detail: Candidate, scrape, tool-call, turn, and spend limits are controlled by application code rather than model instructions.

engineeringDecisions.title: Treat research as evidence, not truth
engineeringDecisions.detail: Qualification stores source URLs, confidence, fit reasons, concerns, and review states instead of collapsing incomplete research into a binary answer.

reliability.title: Safe pause, resume, and cancellation
reliability.detail: Control requests are checked at safe execution points and saved state avoids repeating completed research unnecessarily.

reliability.title: Prompt-injection boundary
reliability.detail: Scraped website content is untrusted data and cannot alter objectives, runtime limits, or the available tool surface.

reliability.title: No-send boundary
reliability.detail: The agent has no email, SMTP, LinkedIn sending, or personal-email lookup tool; it stops at reviewed drafts.

reliability.title: Deterministic provider testing
reliability.detail: Recorded provider fixtures keep routine tests repeatable and prevent accidental provider spend.

result: A review-first research system that can carry a lead from objective to evidence-backed qualification and outreach drafts while keeping uncertainty, provider failures, spend, and human approval explicit.

evidence.label: Source repository
evidence.description: Public monorepo with web, worker, core domain rules, database migrations, and test suites.

evidence.label: Automated verification
evidence.description: Repository includes unit, contract, integration, replay, and Playwright end-to-end coverage.

title: RAG Application
summary: A multi-user RAG application with authentication, persistent document storage, vector retrieval, conversation memory, and user isolation across storage, vector, and database layers.
problem: A document-chat demo becomes a real application only when users can authenticate, upload multiple document formats, retain their files, isolate knowledge from other users, preserve conversation context, and manage documents without leaking state between storage layers.
system: A FastAPI backend authenticates users with Google OAuth, stores uploaded documents in Google Cloud Storage, indexes document chunks into user-namespaced Pinecone vectors, persists metadata and conversation state in MongoDB, and streams grounded answers through an Agno RAG agent.

engineeringDecisions.title: Isolate every persistence layer
engineeringDecisions.detail: GCS prefixes, Pinecone namespaces, and MongoDB filters all carry the user identity instead of relying on a single isolation boundary.

engineeringDecisions.title: Persist source files
engineeringDecisions.detail: Uploads are stored in GCS rather than temporary local disk so document management remains durable across server restarts.

engineeringDecisions.title: Keep conversational state
engineeringDecisions.detail: Session history and agent memory are persisted separately from document vectors to support contextual follow-up questions.

reliability.title: Secure session cookies
reliability.detail: Authentication uses server-side session handling with HTTP-only cookies and time-limited serialization.

reliability.title: Coordinated deletion
reliability.detail: Document deletion removes the corresponding file, vector entries, and metadata instead of leaving stale knowledge behind.

reliability.title: Multi-format ingestion
reliability.detail: PDF, DOCX, and TXT inputs flow through the same upload and indexing boundary.

result: A reusable authenticated RAG backend that treats document storage, retrieval, user isolation, memory, and lifecycle operations as first-class product concerns rather than only demonstrating retrieval quality.

evidence.label: Source repository
evidence.description: FastAPI application, storage helpers, agent configuration, and document-processing code.
